title: Wanderer's Guild
description: Professions for dnd5e built on tool proficiencies: a character has every profession whose tool they are proficient with, and its rank follows the proficiency bonus. Recipes learned by rank, from recipe items or from the GM, and crafting with the linked tool check, gathering at map nodes, in a scene's area or from defeated creatures, on rules the GM fills in. A GM setup window, Professions, Crafting and Gather windows per character, and a page on Wanderer's Toolkit's character sheet.

recommends.reason: Optional. Crafting prices can show and charge the toolkit's three-coin economy; a Professions page on its character sheet (2.3.0+); its journeys reset gathering limits. Read through its API and hooks.
Optional. A later version may hand gathered items out with Item Piles when it is active.
